## pyffmpegcore {{ tag }}: safer terminal output

Human-readable CLI reports escape terminal control and formatting characters
from untrusted media metadata, file paths, plans, and diagnostics. JSON output
retains structured string values.

### Verification

- Exact release artifact checks on Linux, macOS, and Windows with Python 3.10
  and 3.14: [release workflow]({{ release_run_url }})
